newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP shares up in active early trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP shares up in active early trade.

text.p: Shares in resources giant The Broken Hill Pty Co (BHP) Ltd opened firmer in active early trade on Friday after a week-long dive that had wiped five percent from its share price and took it to a two-year low on Thursday.
BHP opened 22 cents higher at A$16.22 before slipping back to A$16.08 by 10.20 a.m. (0020 GMT) on turnover of 3.4 million shares.
"BHP has bounced -- it was oversold early yesterday before some strong fund buying brought it back up later in the day," said James Capel senior trader Stephen Streeter.
"It seems to have stabilised today, although it's come off a bit since the open," he said.
"It's just bouncing back," said another senior Sydney trader, adding that BHP and its fellow resources giant RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd had been oversold.
CRA was up 42 cents at A$18.25 at 11.05 a.m. (0105 GMT)
